blocks.html:
Disney’s Cinderella Themed Full Wrap – Volkswagen Beetle 2015

One of the reasons why people prefer to get a vinyl wrap for their vehicles is the endless possibilities. There are no restrictions on the kind of design you can get on your vehicle. Our recent client proves it.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we appreciate the creative and interesting ideas that our clients come up with to wrap their vehicles. It is a way for them to personalize their vehicle to look exactly the way they want.

We recently had the pleasure to work with Ms. Andrea and bring her Disney fantasy to life. She contacted us about getting a full vinyl wrap for her Volkswagen Beetle 2015. At first, it must seem like a regular wrap request. However, when our team discussed the details with her, we found out she wanted to do something very special.

She wanted to wrap her entire Volkswagen Beetle in a theme that was inspired by the Disney Princess Cinderella. Now that’s a great way to show off what you’re passionate about. This idea of hers was inspired by something she saw online. She came across this image of a Volkswagen Beetle that had a similar theme to it and she immediately got her heart set on getting it for herself. She wanted the same theme but she gave it her own touch by rearranging and adding some extra elements. She reached out to the person whose car she saw online to ask their permission if it would be alright if she gets her car done in a similar theme.

It was an interesting project for our designers and installers working with us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto. We did the job with great pleasure and brought her vision to reality. It was a full wrap for which we used Avery Dennison’s SW900 Diamond White & Gloss Smokey Blue. Installers at Vinyl Wrap Toronto only use premium quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M, because when it comes to our client’s pride and joys, there are to be no compromises with quality.

The procedure our installers followed was to wrap the entire car in Avery’s Gloss Smokey Blue vinyl and then on top of that Smokey Blue, we added the Diamond White decal to achieve the look as shown in the mockup prepared by our skilled team of designers. For the little details, we installed decals/lettering saying “Cinderella” on the sides and a mini-castle on the back & front.

Even though our part to wrap the car is done, she still has some modifications she wants to make to her car. A vinyl Wrap was a part of her journey to make her Volkswagen Beetle truly unique. We appreciate her allowing us to bring her one step closer to her fantasy car.

We have attached some pictures of the wrapped Volkswagen Beetle on this page for you to see how an ordinary car can turn into your dream car. She wanted a Disney theme and yours could be anything you want. All you have to do is give us a call and talk to one of our experts to get the ball rolling.

Update: Ms. Andrea has reupholstered the interior to match the Smokey Gloss Blue and Gloss White vinyl.

If you’ve got a vehicle that could use a bit of vinyl goodness, feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage. We’re located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, M9W1B4. We’d love to have you over for a tour and answer any questions you may have.
